description: Send a new Canvas Inbox message, e.g. to a professor or classmate. Recipients get it immediately. Get recipient IDs from find_recipients; to answer an existing thread, use reply_to_conversation. [NEEDS CONFIRMATION: call it once for a preview and a confirm_token, show the preview to the user, and only if they say yes call it again with the same arguments, confirm=true and that confirm_token. Apps that can ask the user directly show a confirmation instead.]

body.description: Message body text. Plain text or simple HTML.

confirm.description: Set to true together with confirm_token to carry out a request you already previewed.

confirm_token.description: The one-time token from the preview. Only use it after the user has said yes.

separate_threads.description: Send individually rather than as a group thread

name: send_message
title: Send Message
